resources.string: An independent app using your own Telegram account. No app-owned storage server.
Files and metadata are encrypted on your device before Telegram upload. Keep your recovery phrase safe.
Telegram login and vault recovery are separate. Losing your vault passphrase may permanently lose access to encrypted files.
Telegram file-size and rate limits apply. Capacity, retention and account access are not guaranteed. TG Photos is not an official Telegram app.
Enter your Telegram verification details here only. This is not your vault recovery passphrase.
Telegram sign-in is unavailable in this package. Install an updated TG Photos package or contact the app provider.
The secure Telegram connection could not load on this device. Install a compatible TG Photos update without clearing app data.
The local Telegram session key cannot be opened. Do not overwrite the existing session. Follow the recovery guidance.
Telegram requires confirmation from another signed-in device. Open this Telegram confirmation link yourself on a trusted device.
Telegram requires an official purchase step for this login. Complete it in an official Telegram client, then try again.
Telegram requested a newer authentication step. Update TG Photos; login has not been completed.
Telegram session closed. Restart TG Photos to sign in again.
I have read and accept these Telegram terms
Telegram rejected the details. Check them and try again.
Telegram asks you to wait before retrying.
Telegram is unavailable. Check your connection and try again later.
The request could not be completed. Try again later.
Telegram did not respond in time. It may still process the request; wait before retrying.
Your Telegram session is connected. Unlock or set up your encrypted library to continue.
Your private library keeps files, albums and transfers together. Choose the section you need.
Language follows your Android settings: English or Bengali.
End this app’s Telegram session? Your Telegram messages will not be deleted. Restart the app to sign in again.
